description: Complete the record: pass the BODY_JSON from prepare_usdc_settlement UNCHANGED and the signature your worker wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to POST /labor/settle, the same public door any HTTP client uses, with no payment and no key; this server holds no keys and no funds. A body that carries any field beyond workId, workerWallet, paymentTxHash and nonce is refused here. The settlement door reads the chain, then answers: settled, or refused with its reason, in which case nothing was recorded and the job stays open to the real payment. If the chain read outlasts this call, the reply says so; do not sign again, read work_status. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_usdc_settlement, unchanged.

signature.description: The 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN (a smart wallet's wrapped signature can be long).
